headlines.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it interferes with Strait of Hormuz deal
headlines.description: President Donald Trump threatened to strike Oman if it interferes in a potential deal over control of the Strait of Hormuz. Trump also told the military to cut back joint exercises with South Korea after it stayed out of the Iran war. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: Tupac murder trial legal teams lay out framework of their case in opening statements
headlines.description: The prosecution and defense delivered their opening statements in Tupac Shakur's murder trial. NBC News' Misty Marris discusses how the prosecution laid the framework for their case while defense attacked the credibility the case's credibility.

headlines.title: House ethics panel says it’s investigating Rep. Jimmy Gomez over allegation of ‘sexual misconduct’
headlines.description: The California Democrat said he’d “made personal mistakes outside my marriage” but said he hadn’t violated the law or House Ethics rules.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere, 'Heroes' and 'Nashville' Actor, Dies at 36
headlines.description: Police are investigating the sudden death of Hayden Panettiere, star of TV and film, after being found unresponsive at her South Carolina home. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Childhood vaccine exemptions for personal or religious reasons hit new record, CDC finds
headlines.description: The number of parents in the U.S. choosing not to vaccinate their children rose dramatically in the last school year, according to data released Monday by the CDC.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
